look: Photoreal 35mm film still, Kodak Vision3 500T grain, low-key chiaroscuro from practical light sources, deep blacks, humid tropical air. Adult underground arthouse erotica in the tradition of Roversi, Saudek and Newton: real skin with pores, sweat and water on skin, sheer wet fabric, raw emotion on the face. No text, no letters, no watermark, no logo.
motion_look: Photoreal live-action, 35mm film grain, slow deliberate cinematic camera, natural physics and breathing, the same woman from the start frame throughout, her face and body unchanged, no text on screen.
negative: cartoon, anime, CGI, 3D render, plastic skin, airbrushed, deformed hands, extra fingers, morphing face, identity change, text, subtitles, letters, watermark, logo, fast cuts

kira_ref.prompt: Character reference portrait. A Russian woman of about 32: high cheekbones, grey-green eyes, straight dark-chestnut hair falling past her shoulders, pale skin, full lips, a thin old scar through her left eyebrow. Bare shoulders, a thin black silk camisole strap. She looks straight into the lens, calm and tired, lips slightly parted. Soft window light from the left, dark background, head and shoulders, sharp focus on the eyes.
